notes.title: Version a0.49.1 Changelog
notes.content:
-Rollback (i.e. using mouse scrolling to rewind dialogue and game events) has been disabled as using this feature often break game code and causes crashes.
-Optional intro dialogue has been slightly adjusted.
-Falling unconscious after drinking too much should no longer crash the game.
-Characters now have their own sex cooldown timer instead of a shared one.
-Sigrid should now have her jogging outfit on when she asks you to come jog with her.
-The Inventory button should no longer stop working for no reason.
-Predators should no longer vore the player when they already have too many prey inside of them or if the player chose not to share a belly at game start.
-Euthalia should no longer be drinking while underwater.
-Bessie should no longer ask you if you want to come out when she has no intention of letting you out.
-Switching to a language that has yet to be translated no longer makes the Preferences menu go invisible.
-Minor fixes.
-Implemented parts of voraphile's Voracious patch (up to v2.45)
---Worked around the uninitialized 'likes' for the new NPC characters which caused a crash when "getting to know" them in conversation.
---Fixed the missing closing time detection for the places where the player character could meet and have a conversation with the new NPC characters.
---Fixed the missing closing_time_during_conversation function that would cause crash when speaking with a NPC character.
---Fixed the crash bug in check_character_schedules that could sometimes occur when loading a saved game.

notes.title: Version a0.48.1 Changelog
notes.content:
-The game will now gradually be populated by up to 18 procedurally generated NPCs that can be interacted with by the player and eaten by predators, provided that predators are allowed to eat NPCs.
-Bessie can now vore Jen, but she will never fully digest her.
-Added visuals for bigger bellies for Bessie, Catalina, and Euthalia, depending on the number of prey they have inside of them.
-Characters will no longer leave without saying anything when you're talking to them.
-Translation files have been fixed.
-You should now be able to buy drinks for NPC prey without the game crashing.
-You should no longer find yourself in Bessie's womb after she swallows you orally.
-Sigrid should now take off her clothes when she takes you home with her.
-The game should no longer randomly crash, or at the very least crash less often.
-Minor fixes.
-Implemented parts of voraphile's Voracious patch (up to v2.42):
---Fixed the ambiance outside sounds not always stopping when switching back to inside POV.
-Implemented Flurby's AutoNoWait mod, which adds the "Auto Skip" option and an "Auto Skip Time" slider in Preferences. When enabled, Auto Skip will make any dialogue progress by itself, the speed of which is determined by the Auto Skip Time slider.

notes.title: Version a0.47.2 Changelog
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Can now ask characters about the whereabouts of other characters.
[*] Code overhaul for character visuals.
[*] "ScriptError: could not find label 'prey01_check_bellysize'." will no longer occur.
[*] Characters will no longer randomly change clothes when you're talking to them.
[*] Preds' bellies will no longer go flat while you're inside of them.
[*] Minor Fixes
[/list]

Implemented parts of voraphile's Voracious patch (up to v2.40):
[list]
[*] Added a "Masturbate" button to the in-belly actions, which appears a little before the player character would be overwhelmed with their lust and would "auto-masturbate". This allows to trigger the masturbation earlier.
[*] Properly increment the time and count a "digestion tick" after each Beg action while past the fatality threshold.
[*] Avoid repeating the same predator action when the player character begs twice in a row while far past the fatality threshold limit.
[*] Added new "gluttonous vore" scene opportunities with Bessie after having developed a good relationship with her and/or Jen, when drinking her milk or asking how she makes ice creams from it.
[*] Fixed the bug that allowed to watch TV with Sigrid while she was asleep.
[*] Added the possibility to buy scratchcards in batches.
[*] Winning $100k in the lottery and getting the achievement for it now unlocks the ability to throw away your excess lottery tickets.
[*] Properly report "You feel your skin tingle..." when the life saver effect stops, and not yet too far gone or far past fatality threshold (it could fail to be reported in some cases, and was wrongly reported when the player character could not feel any such thing any more).
[*] Fixed the bug that caused Elaine to disappear from the screen after a first dialog exchange in various venues (e.g. at the Hospital or in the Park).
[*] Properly check for venues (bar, gym) close time and interrupt dialogs with the predators accordingly.
[*] Fixed improper detection of the conversing Stockbroker when on phone, that could lead to other unrelated menus (e.g. the Pawn shop one) to be displayed after ending the conversation.
[*] Do not display money amounts with more than two decimal digits, and round up all appraisal values (from either Doris or the player character) to the closest dollar in the Pawn shop.
[*] Beautified the stocks trading menu by properly aligning texts and buttons.
[*] Allow the player character to eat and drink (via the "Use" inventory action) the candies/food and beverage they buy at the supermarket (but only chocolate bars and gummy candies can be eaten while inside a large belly).
[*] Fixed the scene in the bar not updating to show the currently present predators while drinking alone several shots in a raw. Note that this does not "fix" (rather "add") Bessie's presence since there is no picture for her sitting in the bar. It does not fix either the presence updates while chatting with a predator (but the update will happen at the end of the conversation nonetheless, so it is not a real issue).
[*] Fixed a bug (duplicate return labels numbering) that was causing some phone conversations with the stock broker to enter the pawnshop menu.
[*] Fixed a bug (lack of variables zeroing when leaving the pawnshop) that could cause Doris to pay you more than what was agreed to after an appraisal.
[*] Properly make predators refuse a simple request to be let out when in a "gluttonous vore" scene.
[*] Properly account for the fact you asked to be let out, even when a predator refuses the request.
[*] Fix for missing hospital janitor job parameters, causing a crash.
[*] Fix for Sigrid unbirthing the player character over the phone line.
[*] Fixed a couple typos in Elaine's job recommendation dialogs.
[*] Factored time-ticking code during vore scene, which also fixed a few missing updates in the various promises (to be let out, to provide food, etc) counters.
[*] In willing vore scenes, do not any more prevent the prey to ask for food or lifesaver after they begged to be released and the predator promised to let them out later on.
[*] Properly account for the fatality threshold for several dialogues instead of using fixed 50% and 25% health levels to choose between their three versions. Also applies to the prey_beg_to_let_out dialogues (7 levels).
[/list]

notes.title: Version a0.42.1 Changelog
notes.content:

[*] Characters you have a high relationship with can now come to your rescue if they hear you screaming from inside of a predator's belly. Please note that this feature is currently very bare-bones as of this update.

[*] If the player is inside of their bellies, Sigrid and Euthalia will now interact with them before falling asleep and after waking up.
[*] Epitaphs are now translatable.
[*] WhatTheBOOM's updated French translation has been added.
[*] Mixa's updated Russian translation has been added.
[*] A pred whose belly a player is in should no longer disappear when the player ends the conversation.
[*] Preds should no longer wake up in the middle of the night to tell the player "good night".
[*] The inventory button should no longer become permanently disabled when the player is just out and about.
[*] Preds should no longer confront themselves when the player screams for help.
[*] Sigrid should no longer shower twice in the morning while having the player in her belly.
[*] Minor fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Changelog for a0.41.1
notes.content:
[list]
[*] The game has been updated to use Python 3.x instead of Python 2.7.
[*] Leaving the parking lot should no longer teleport you back home when you're visiting someone.
[*] Asking Jasmine to unbirth you will now actually get you unbirthed.
[*] It now takes significantly less time to be squeezed out of a pred's intestines when they're actually trying to get you out.
[*] Taking the action to Wait while inside of a belly no longer skips pred actions.
[*] You can now talk to preds while in their belly, provided that they can hear you.
[*] Preds will now only let you out if they have some privacy, unless you force your way out. However, they can promise to let you out once they're no longer out in public... provided that they remember said promise.
[*] While in a pred's stomach, you can request them to eat food or swallow a lifesaver tablet in willing vore scenarios.
[*] Elaine and Jasmine will now interact with you before they fall asleep and when they wake up if you're inside of their bellies. This feature will be added to the other preds in future updates.
[*] The game no longer crash when playing Texas Hold 'em with Jasmine and betting with something other than money.
[*] If you've hit the relationship cap for a character and the relationship bar has turned gray, it will now turn back to green once you're able to increase your relationship with that character again.
[*] Preds should no longer spit you out for no reason.
[*] The library will no longer require you to leave in-between study sessions.
[*] You will no longer get stuck in the public bathroom.
[*] There's now a chance that Jasmine will barge into the bathroom when you're in the shower between 8 AM and 10 AM.
[*] Jasmine will avoid eating you if she has someone in her belly and you picked *"Preds can eat other prey, but I don't want to share a belly with anyone."* at game start.
[*] You should no longer find yourself in a pred's intestines after asking to be let out of their womb.
[*] Minor fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Changelog for Version a0.39.2
notes.content:
[list]
[*] The game has received a major overhaul that is intended to do two things: 1) allow a theoretically unlimited amount of mods to be installed, and 2) to pave the way for future updates.
[*] You can now cook more food in less time and order up to 50 portions when feeding Jasmine, but more food is now needed to sate her hunger.
[*] New options at the start of the game makes it possible to adjust the ruthlessness of predators, as well as the digestion speed of herbivores compared to carnivores and omnivores.
[*] The relationship window can now be freely dragged around the screen.
[*] Relationships now go from -200 to 200 instead of -100 to 100. Furthermore, a maximum relationship cap has been added that increases once a day when you interact with a character, with the amount of this daily increase being based on the player's Charisma. This is intended to dissuade relationship grinding, and instead make relationships grow in a more realistic fashion.
[*] Added new internal graphics for stomach fullness.
[*] Sigrid should no longer have any issues with drunkenness.
[*] Jasmine's feeding event should now trigger as normal.
[*] Jasmine should now sleep until 10:00 AM.
[*] Switching views now works while inside of Elaine.
[*] Talking with Elaine should no longer crash the game.
[*] Characters should now appear on the screen when you're talking to them.
[*] Jasmine's sunbathing event will now trigger correctly.
[*] Being in the secluded part of the beach should no longer cause a crash to menu.
[*] Being unbirthed will now take you to the womb instead of the stomach.
[*] Playing cards with Jasmine should no longer result in an error.
[*] Modders can now add custom epitaphs more easily.
[*] The valuable items inside of a pred's stomach will no longer keep growing as times goes on.
[*] You can now search Euthalia's womb for valuable items if you chose the Digestion/Absorption unbirth option at game start.
[*] Elaine should no longer ask you to pay $0 in rent.
[*] You can now deposit money at the bank as normal.
[*] NPC prey should now be visible inside of pred stomachs.
[*] All preds should now be visible in the post-digestion scene.
[*] The maximum relationship cap now grows faster early on but slows down the higher it gets.
[*] Added the Mod class to make it easier for modders to update and manage their mods.
[*] Minor fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Version a0.37.0 Update Notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] The game now regularly deletes the call stack, which should prevent it from slowing down or crashing due to an accumulation of junk data.
[*] Choice menus now have a scroll bar if there are 15 or more options.
[*] Completely filling up Drunkenness now results in death unless you're inside of a belly.
